summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with a parametrized test plus non-node and graph-unchanged tests. Tests pass: the new module and test/test_path.py give 40 passed, and test/test_extras gives 98 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not in the prepared venv and I was not allowed to install them, so type-ignore placement and formatting are unchecked. Nothing committed.
